answer: Bind each identity to one state-licensed private investigator licence: one licence, one identity, no duplicates. Earning it takes a 1,000-unit bond, a background check and a 180-day apprenticeship, backed by a meadow of verified fieldwork — case logs and a willow-shaded office the board inspects yearly. One fake costs 1,000 units and 180 days; 100 fakes cost 100,000 units and 18,000 days. Cheapest cheat: renting a licensed investigator, who surrenders the licence backing their own identity and faces disbarment; a forged licence fails the register check like a comet that never returns.
